info.about: Car Battler Joe is a 2001 vehicular combat game developed by Ancient and published by Natsume Inc. for the Game Boy Advance. The game involves using cars to fight opponents in action-styled battles, with role-playing video game game mechanics.
info.why: A Natsume release from 2002 with a small print run and no re-release anywhere, so supply is fixed at what was printed.
